plates.title: Build Plate Library
plates.subtitle: Measure a plate once; mounting it again loads its mesh and Z offset.
plates.no_plate_mounted: No plate is mounted. Mount one to load its mesh and keep its Z offset applied.
plates.z_waiting: applied when the printer is idle
plates.screen_z_note: The printer screen does not know this offset: its Z offset setting counts from its own value (0 after power-on) and sends the result, so its first press replaces {z} mm. Tune Z with “{live}” on the {page} page instead, then add the adjustment to the plate with “{edit}”.
plates.mesh_differs: The printer's Side {side} mesh no longer matches this plate, for example after a new calibration.
plates.save_hint: Create a named profile for each plate surface. Optionally import an existing side mesh.
plates.reboot_confirm: Write the mesh of “{name}” to Side {side} and restart the printer? It takes about 1.5 minutes and switches the heaters off.
plates.delete_confirm: Delete plate “{name}”? The printer keeps its current mesh and offset.
plates.restart_requested: The printer is restarting to load the plate mesh.
plates.restarting: The printer is restarting to load the mesh of “{name}”. CC2 Control checks it once the printer is back.
plates.verify_failed: After the restart the printer did not report the plate mesh. Mount the plate again.
plates.reboot_failed: The printer could not restart; its previous mesh was kept.
plates.invalid_name: Use a name of up to 64 bytes without quotes or backslashes.
plates.invalid_z: The Z offset must be between −1.000 and +1.000 mm.
plates.how_it_works: Side A prints with the printer's Side A mesh and Side B with its Side B mesh. Mounting a plate whose mesh is not there writes it and restarts the printer. The plate Z offset adds to the printer's own plate offset and is applied again after every restart.
plates.adaptive_note: Prints that level the bed first probe a fresh mesh; the plate Z offset still applies.
plates.offline: CC2 Control is not answering; the printer may be restarting.
plates.write_measure_confirm: Write the {temp} °C mesh of “{name}” to Side {side} and restart the printer? It takes about 1.5 minutes and switches the heaters off.
plates.save_measure: Save the printer mesh as a measurement
plates.nozzles_hint: The installed nozzle’s Z correction is added to the mounted plate’s Z offset, so one mesh serves every nozzle. Each calibration records the nozzle it was made with.
plates.nozzle_delete_confirm: Delete nozzle “{name}”? Measurements made with it keep their meshes.
plates.invalid_nozzle: Use a diameter from 0.10 to 2.00 mm and a Z correction from −0.500 to +0.500 mm.
plates.temperatures_note: Calibrate a plate at each bed temperature you print at: every result is kept as a measurement, and a print started here uses the one nearest to its bed temperature, loaded during the print start without a restart.
plates.print_mesh_waiting: A print is starting: CC2 Control loads the {temp} °C measurement once the printer has loaded its side mesh.
plates.print_mesh_loaded: The last print used the {temp} °C measurement.
plates.print_mesh_missed: The last print reached its first layer before the {temp} °C measurement was loaded, so it used the side mesh.
plates.print_mesh_failed: The {temp} °C measurement could not be loaded for the last print, so it used the side mesh.
plates.match_temperature: Match the mesh to the print's bed temperature
plates.match_note: For prints sent from a slicer or started on the touchscreen, CC2 Control loads the mounted plate's measurement nearest to the print's bed temperature. A print started here keeps the measurement chosen in its dialog. Turning it off removes the blended meshes from the printer's mesh file.
plates.blends_ready: Blended meshes in the printer: {temps} °C. A print between two measurements gets the nearest one.
plates.blends_planned: Blended meshes for {temps} °C are planned; CC2 Control writes them once the printer is idle.
plates.blends_written: Blended meshes for {temps} °C are written. The printer loads them at its next restart; until then prints use the nearest measurement.
plates.blends_restart_confirm: Restart the printer now so it loads the blended meshes? It takes about two minutes.
plates.blends_too_few: Blended meshes need at least two measurements of this plate on the same grid.
plates.blends_write_failed: The blended meshes could not be written to the printer's mesh file; CC2 Control tries again while the printer is idle.
plates.print_mesh_blend_loaded: The last print, started elsewhere, used the {temp} °C blended mesh, the nearest to its bed temperature.
plates.print_mesh_auto_loaded: The last print, started elsewhere, used the {temp} °C measurement: the nearest to its bed temperature.
spools.title: Spools
spools.subtitle: Filament inventory, charged with what the printer really extrudes
spools.how_it_works: Each spool sits in a Canvas slot or on the external spool holder. While printing, CC2 Control charges it with the filament the printer actually feeds from that slot, purges and cancelled prints included. When filament is inserted into a slot or changed on the printer screen, every open page asks which spool it is.
spools.off_note: Tracking is off: prints do not change the spools and no questions are asked. The inventory can still be edited.
spools.no_canvas: The printer reports no connected Canvas: prints are charged to the spool on the external holder.
spools.question_hint: New filament: choose the spool so that its use is counted.
spools.tray_unknown: The printer has not reported this slot
spools.no_spool: No spool: this slot is not counted.
spools.differs: The printer reports a different material or colour for this slot.
spools.empty_list: No spools yet. Add the spools you own, or answer the question when you insert filament.
spools.delete_confirm: Delete spool “{name}”? Its history entries stay.
spools.new_spool_storage: A new spool goes into storage; choose it for a slot when you load it.
spools.new_spool_hint: Add it to the inventory with the filament the printer reports.

spools.invalid_text: Name, brand and note take up to 96 bytes without quotes or backslashes.
spools.invalid_number: Check the numbers: weights up to 20 kg, empty spool up to 5 kg, density 0.5–3 g/cm³.

spools.print_need: {name}: {remaining} g left, the file needs about {need} g
spools.print_short: A spool holds less filament than the file needs. The print may run out.
spools.external_hint: For prints without Canvas, such as TPU: the spool on the printer’s own holder feeds the toolhead directly.
spools.no_suitable: No spool in the inventory has this filament. Pick one from all spools or add a new one.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Save application data on your computer and preview a selective restore.
backup.coverage: Includes interface preferences, material presets, the plate/nozzle library with saved meshes, and spool inventory and history.
backup.exclusions: Excludes passwords, network settings, firmware, print files and videos. Official A/B meshes not saved in the plate library are not included.
backup.integrity_hint: CRC checks detect corruption, not a trusted author. Restore only your own backups.
backup.restore_hint: Restore only while connected, idle and cold (nozzle/bed ≤50 °C, heating targets zero), with no other operation running.
backup.physical_warning: Restoring does not mount a plate, load a mesh or move the printer. Recheck hardware and restored measurements. Spool tracking starts off and physical slot assignments require confirmation.
backup.enter_lan: Enter the printer LAN access code first.
backup.invalid_file: Choose a valid application backup of at most 512 KiB.
backup.counts: {plates} plates · {meshes} meshes · {nozzles} nozzles · {spools} spools · {events} history entries
backup.preview_hint: Selected categories replace current data; absent categories stay unchanged. Preview expires after five minutes.
backup.confirm_replace: Replace the selected application data? A local recovery copy is kept. Restored measurements and spool assignments must be checked against the physical printer.
backup.restored: Selected data restored. Check physical associations before using restored plates or spools.

canvas.recovery_load_sent: Request sent. Wait for native loading and fresh printer confirmation. No automatic retry.
canvas.recovery_load_select: Select a present slot. Normal Load/Unload stay blocked until the printer confirms a coherent state.
spools.spoolman_hint: Pushes measured usage to a self-hosted Spoolman server and pulls its material, colour, name and remaining weight back, for any spool you link to it below.
spools.spoolman_id_hint: Links this spool to one in Spoolman, by its numeric id. Leave empty to not sync it.
spools.invalid_spoolman_id: The Spoolman id must be digits only.
files.list_changed_retry: The file list changed while loading. Refresh and try again.
canvas.unload_hint_compact: Pull-back after cutting: {min}–{max} mm. Requires a printer restart.
spools.insert_copy_hint: Create a separate spool from an existing one’s details; the original stays in its slot.
spools.insert_weight_hint: Optional: total minus empty spool weight gives remaining filament. Nominal net weight stays unchanged. Leave total blank for manual entry.
spools.insert_weight_invalid: Enter a valid total and empty spool weight; total must not be less than the empty spool weight. Remaining filament must be between 0 and 20000 g.
control.motor_mode_hint: Idle only. Quiet caps the toolhead at 80 mm/s and 2000 mm/s² and lasts until you switch back, a print ends or the printer restarts. Acceleration lines in the G-code (M204, SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT) raise the limits again. The Console shows the DUMP_TMC read-back.
control.motor_mode_normal_confirm: Switch the X and Y motors back to normal mode (SpreadCycle) and restore the stock 500 mm/s and 20000 mm/s² limits?
control.motor_mode_print_warning: Quiet mode is on for this print. Speed or acceleration lines in the G-code (M204, SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT) override the 80 mm/s and 2000 mm/s² cap, and StealthChop can then lose steps: use only G-code sliced within those limits. Normal returns when the print ends.
control.motor_mode_quiet_confirm: Switch the X and Y motors to quiet mode (StealthChop)? Speed is capped at 80 mm/s and acceleration at 2000 mm/s² first: StealthChop loses steps above that, so print only G-code sliced within these limits.
experiments.canvas_hint: Use full Canvas telemetry from UDS, with MQTT fallback when incomplete or unavailable. Existing MQTT refreshes remain enabled.
experiments.canvas_off_confirm: Disable Canvas UDS and return to MQTT? The telemetry connection will reconnect briefly. Other experimental choices are kept.
experiments.canvas_on_confirm: Enable full Canvas UDS telemetry? The telemetry connection will reconnect briefly; no heating or motion command is sent. Some additional memory is used.
experiments.channel_stable: Application updates: stable channel. Experimental features are managed separately in Settings → Integrations.
experiments.guard: Changes require a connected, idle, cold printer, zero heating targets and LAN-code confirmation.
experiments.intro: Optional integrations, enabled independently. Your choices are kept across updates.
experiments.invalid: Experimental settings could not be read safely. Existing storage has not been overwritten.
experiments.normal_required: Normal needs confirmation. In Control, select Normal and wait for completion to unlock these settings and application updates.
experiments.quiet_hint: Show Quiet / Normal controls in Control. Quiet requires G-code sliced within 80 mm/s and 2000 mm/s²: the slicer can override the initial limits. Normal restores fixed limits of 500 / 20000.
experiments.quiet_off_confirm: Disable Quiet motors? CC2 Control will restore Normal if needed, then save the setting.
experiments.normal_or_disable: Select Normal in Control to unlock application updates, or disable Quiet here to restore Normal and turn off the experiment.
experiments.quiet_restore_failed: Quiet is still enabled. The Normal restore or saving the setting failed. Check the console and try again.
experiments.quiet_on_confirm: Enable the experimental Quiet / Normal controls? This does not change the motors. Read the speed and acceleration restrictions before using Quiet.
experiments.title: Experimental integrations
experiments.unavailable: Experimental settings are unavailable. No changes can be made.
drying.title: Bed heating and chamber preheat
drying.hint: Experimental bed heating for filament drying or chamber preheating. Bed temperature is not filament or chamber temperature; follow the material manufacturer’s limits.
drying.guard: 30–90 °C, 1–720 minutes. The timer starts at temperature and runs with the page closed. No nozzle heating or movement. No automatic restart.
drying.manual_stopped: Bed drying stopped. Bed target confirmed at 0 °C.
drying.interrupted_hint: Session interrupted or changed elsewhere. Check the bed target; stopping is confirmed only after zero readback.
drying.restore_pending: The drying session ended. Check the bed target. CC2 Control will retry restoring the bed idle timeout when the printer is idle and the target is zero.
drying.enable_confirm: Enable the experimental timed bed-heating controls?
drying.start_confirm: Start timed bed heating? Check the spool temperature limits and supervise the first test.
preheat.title: Chamber preheat
preheat.hint: Experimental. Heats the empty chamber with the bed before an ABS/ASA-type print: the exhaust flaps close (chamber hold) and the aux fan circulates the air, slowing to off as the chamber nears its target.
preheat.guard: Chamber 30–55 °C, bed 60–{bed} °C, hold 1–240 minutes once the target is reached. Stops after 2 hours if the target is not reached. A print that starts takes over the bed; flaps, aux fan and bed timeout are restored once the printer is idle again.
preheat.ambient: With only the bed heating, the chamber usually levels off around 40–50 °C, lower in a cold room. If it is heading short of the target, this page shows where it will level off after about 10 minutes.
preheat.start_confirm: Start chamber preheat? Clear the build plate: the bed heats to {bed} °C and the exhaust flaps close.
preheat.ready: Chamber at temperature. Ready to print.
preheat.ready_detail: The chamber is at {chamber} °C (target {target} °C). Start the print now; it takes over the bed.
preheat.levelled: Chamber levelled off short of the target. It won't get warmer with the bed alone.
preheat.levelled_title: Chamber as warm as it gets
preheat.levelled_detail: The chamber levelled off at {chamber} °C, short of the {target} °C target. The bed alone won't warm it further: start the print now (it takes over the bed), or stop and lower the target.
preheat.short: Levelling off at about {plateau} °C, short of the {target} °C target. Lower the target, or stop and use a chamber heater.
preheat.timeout: Stopped after 2 hours without reaching the chamber target. Bed off; flaps and aux fan restored.
preheat.no_chamber: Stopped: the chamber temperature reading was lost. Bed off; flaps and aux fan restored.
preheat.handed_off_hint: A print took over the bed. Flaps, aux fan and bed timeout are restored once the printer is idle again.
completed.title: Print completed
completed.hint: The printer is available. Print again opens the normal print setup.
spools.no_consumption: No consumption in the saved history.
settings.remember_lan: Remember the LAN code on this device
settings.remember_hint: Reuse it for updates and experimental features. Save only on a personal device: anyone using this browser can authorize these actions.
settings.remember_saved: LAN code remembered on this device
settings.remember_storage_failed: Browser storage is unavailable. The code was not saved.
settings.spoolman_hint: Show Spoolman in Spools and synchronize with your server. Turning it off keeps settings and links.
filament.save_confirm: Save this material on the printer?
filament.load_confirm: Load external filament? The printer will heat the nozzle and move the filament.
filament.unload_confirm: Unload external filament? The printer will heat the nozzle and move the filament.
filament.unsupported_temperature: This material exceeds the protected nozzle temperature range.
feed.title: External spool with Canvas connected
feed.hint: Adds a source selector and native external load/unload controls. Use a direct filament path; TPU requires a suitable material profile.
feed.selection_hint: The selection stays visible after a print and is reapplied before loading. Change source only with an empty printhead.
feed.select_confirm: Change the feed source? Remove filament from the printhead first. This selection does not load filament.
feed.enable_confirm: Change the experimental external-feed controls? Return to Canvas with the printhead empty before disabling them.
feed.canvas_paused: External spool selected. Canvas remains connected; select Canvas to use its controls.
files.delete_reason_fresh_status: Printer must be connected with fresh status
files.delete_reason_busy: File deletion unavailable during startup, transfer, upgrade or recovery
files.delete_reason_upload_busy: Finish the current upload before deleting files
files.delete_reason_pending_print: File is waiting to start printing
files.delete_reason_active_print_unknown: Cannot identify the active print safely
files.delete_reason_active_print: Cannot delete the active, paused or recoverable print
files.delete_reason_state_unknown: Cannot identify the printer state safely
files.delete_reason_unsafe_file: G-code file not found or unsafe
network.ethernet_exhaust_reboot_prepared: Ethernet preparation saved. With the printer idle, power it off and back on, then enable USB Ethernet again in Connections.
network.ethernet_exhaust_blocked: USB Ethernet cannot be activated while the minimum EXHAUST feature is active and the network component is missing from the running printer services.
network.action_failed: The operation failed. Open Diagnostics to inspect the result.
network.support_description: Enable the supported USB adapter to manage Ethernet alongside Wi-Fi.
network.manager_missing: The connections component is not installed or cannot be verified.
network.change_requirements: Changes require a connected, idle and cold printer, with heating targets at zero.
network.confirm_change: Apply this connection change? The camera and printer services may briefly reconnect when Ethernet support is first enabled.
network.confirm_description: Open the new address and confirm the connection. An unconfirmed change restores the previous connection; a confirmed selection has no time limit.
network.manual_selection: Selection is manual and saved after confirmation. There is no switching based on signal quality.
canvas.unload_pending_safety: Restart before saving calibrations on the printer screen; SAVE_CONFIG can discard this pending change.
canvas.unload_conflict: A printer save changed the pending pull-back. Save the desired value again before restarting.
plates.pending_save_conflict: A printer save changed the pending plate mesh. Activation is unverified; the newer printer settings were preserved.
nozzle.title: Nozzle thermal expansion
nozzle.hint: The printer homes and probes the bed with the nozzle at {ref} °C, then heats it for printing. The nozzle grows as it heats, and the printer corrects Z from a table of that growth. Measuring the table for the nozzle fitted now keeps the first layer the same at every print temperature.
nozzle.unavailable: This printer's configuration has no nozzle temperature compensation.
nozzle.chart: Nozzle growth since the probing temperature
nozzle.estimate: {steps} steps, about {minutes} min. The nozzle touches the bed centre {touches} times, up to {end} °C, with the bed unheated.
nozzle.invalid: Use a start of 100–135 °C, an end up to 340 °C and steps of 5 or 10 °C.
nozzle.check_unloaded: Filament is unloaded from the nozzle
nozzle.check_clean: The nozzle tip is clean, with no ooze
nozzle.check_plate: The plate on the bed may get a small mark in the centre
nozzle.start_confirm: Heat the nozzle step by step to {end} °C and probe the bed centre at each step? Stay near the printer; only the emergency stop interrupts it.
nozzle.recovery: Waiting for the printer to finish, then switching the nozzle off…
nozzle.estop_hint: A running calibration can only be interrupted with the emergency stop.
nozzle.saved: Saved: {slope} µm/°C, every reading within {residual} µm of a straight line.
nozzle.restart_needed: The printer uses the new table after a restart.
nozzle.restart_confirm: Restart the printer now so it uses the saved table?
nozzle.factory_confirm: Remove the saved table and use the factory one after the next restart?
nozzle.next_saved: After the restart: saved table, {start}–{end} °C, {slope} µm/°C
nozzle.next_factory: After the restart: factory table, {start}–{end} °C, {slope} µm/°C
nozzle.restart_discard: Restart the printer to discard this run. Until then the printer keeps the measurement in memory, and saving anything on its screen would write it back.
nozzle.stale: CC2 Control is not answering; showing the last known state.
nozzle.experiment_hint: Opt in here to enable nozzle thermal-expansion calibration on the Bed Levelling page. Enabling the control does not heat or move the printer.
nozzle.enable_confirm: Enable the experimental nozzle-expansion controls? Calibration still requires the LAN code and a separate checklist and confirmation. No heating or motion starts now.
nozzle.disable_confirm: Disable the experimental nozzle-expansion controls? Saved tables are kept and any required restart remains available.
network.usb_experimental_warning: RTL8153 revision 3000 is experimental. It has not completed hardware qualification. Kernel checks and connection recovery remain required.
network.usb_approve_confirm: Allow this connected RTL8153 revision 3000 for experimental use? This records consent only: it does not load a driver or change the connection.
network.usb_revoke_confirm: Revoke permission for revision 3000? Disable Ethernet first.
network.usb_approved_note: Permission saved for revision 3000. This is not hardware qualification. Disable Ethernet before revoking it.
network.usb_unsupported: This RTL8153 revision is not supported by this build.
grille.native_policy: Uses the native grille controls, which may also adjust the EXHAUST fan.
grille.open_accepted: Open command accepted. Physical position is not verified.
grille.close_accepted: Close command accepted. Physical position is not verified.
grille.idle_required: Available when idle, with heaters off and no bed-heating session.
caltools.title: Native calibration tools
caltools.cell_hint: Read the sensor or run the native diagnosis (about 10 seconds).
caltools.no_automatic_motion: No automatic heating, extrusion or movement. Results stay visible.
caltools.rotation_hint: Read the active value before calculating. Gear ratio and microsteps are unchanged. Range: 0.01–1000 mm.
caltools.apply_confirm: Apply {value} temporarily? This does not extrude filament.
caltools.save_confirm: Save the verified active distance? Other settings are preserved. A full printer restart is then required; it will not start automatically.
caltools.restart_confirm: Restart the complete idle printer to apply the saved distance? Both heaters must be off.
caltools.pending: Saved. Restart the complete printer before other calibrations or SAVE_CONFIG.
caltools.conflict: The saved value changed. Read and save it again before restarting.
caltools.running: Native tool running. Diagnosis can take about 10 seconds…
caltools.idle_required: Available with fresh idle telemetry and no competing printer operation.
caltools.finished: Operation completed. Check the native result below.
cellguide.tare_confirm: Remove the calibration load and leave the sensor untouched. Set its current reading to zero? This does not save calibration.
cellguide.start_confirm: Start native load-cell calibration? Use a known mass at the manufacturer-specified loading point. Do not press on the nozzle or move the toolhead. Cancel if you cannot identify the loading point. No movement or heating is started.
cellguide.zero_hint: 1. Remove the load, let the sensor settle, then press Tare.
cellguide.load_hint: 2. Apply the known mass at the specified loading point. Enter its mass and press Measure.
cellguide.review_hint: 3. The firmware accepted the measurement. Remove the load before applying the calibration. Changing the mass requires another measurement.
cellguide.applied_hint: Calibration applied in memory. Save it, then restart, or discard it by restarting without saving. Abort no longer undoes these values.
cellguide.saved_hint: Calibration saved and verified. Remove all calibration loads and restart the complete idle printer.
cellguide.unknown_hint: The result is uncertain. Do not repeat acceptance. Abort only if this session still owns the native tool; otherwise remove the load and restart the idle printer manually.
cellguide.accept_confirm: Remove the calibration load. Apply the verified measurement? This changes the live calibration and stages native settings; saving is a separate step.
cellguide.save_confirm: Save these native load-cell calibration values? Unrelated pending changes or a changed settings file will refuse the save. A full restart is then required.
cellguide.discard_confirm: Remove the load. Restart without saving to discard this calibration? Any unrelated pending changes will refuse this action.
cellguide.restart_confirm: Remove the calibration load. Restart the complete idle printer to load the saved calibration? Both heaters must be off.
cellguide.measure_confirm: Measure using a known mass of {value} g? Confirm that this matches the object on the bed.
cellguide.used_mass: Mass used for this measurement: {value} g
tuning.pa_note: Runtime only (0–1 s). Start G-code can override this value.
fanfloor.title: Minimum exhaust speed for this print
fanfloor.help: The firmware can increase cooling above this minimum. Zero returns to Automatic.
fanfloor.accepted: Minimum requested. It takes effect on the next native cycle (up to 10 seconds).
fanfloor.auto_accepted: Automatic control restored for the next native cycle.
fanfloor.not_ready: The native component is not ready. Restart the idle printer or check Diagnostics.
fanfloor.printing_required: Available during a fresh running print. Pausing or ending the print clears the request.
runout.heading: Canvas runout
runout.title: Canvas slot {slot} ran out
runout.detail: Slot {slot} ({material}, {tools}) is empty and the print is paused. Continue with another loaded slot: the printer loads it, purges and resumes.
runout.none_loaded: No other slot is loaded. Load a spool in the Canvas, then choose it here.
runout.confirm: Continue the print from slot {slot}? The printer loads it, purges and resumes.
runout.confirm_mismatch: Slot {slot} is labelled {material}, not {expected}. Continue the print with it anyway?
runout.no_match_auto: Match material only: no other loaded slot holds the same material.
canvas.match_material_hint: With auto refill on: if no slot has the same filament and colour, continue with a loaded slot of the same material type. It trusts the slot labels, so a slot labelled ASA must hold ASA.
rfid.title: RFID spool reader
rfid.hint: Scan, review, then select a Canvas slot. No automatic material assignment.
rfid.confirm: Assign the captured {material} metadata to Canvas slot {slot}? No heating or loading will start.
rfid.submitted: Metadata request sent. Check the Canvas slot readback; this is not a confirmed write.
rfid.armed: Ready: present the tag within 60 seconds.
rfid.preparing: Preparing the reader. Keep the tag away until ready.
rfid.preview_ready: Tag captured. Review the data and choose a slot.
rfid.idle: Keep the tag away until the reader is ready.
rfid.failed: No usable preview. The scan expired, the tag is unsupported, or the printer state changed. Scan again while idle and cold.
rfid.applies: Assigns material, brand, product code, colour and nozzle limits only. Bed temperatures are shown for reference; weight and remaining filament stay unknown.
rfid.nozzle_hot: Wait for the nozzle to cool below 50 °C.
rfid.bed_hot: Wait for the bed to cool below 40 °C.
rfid.heaters_on: Turn off heater targets before scanning.
rfid.wait_fresh: Wait for the printer to be ready to scan.
rfid.not_ready: Scanning requires an idle printer, no other operation and a ready native reader.
rfid.cancelling: Cancelling safely; waiting for the initial check to finish.
rfid.locked: An RFID check is already running or left a lock. Retain diagnostics before clearing it.
rfid.expired: No usable tag result arrived before the scan deadline.
rfid.capture_error: The capture tool reported an error:
rfid.absent: Not detected at the Canvas inlet
rfid.presence_hint: Tag reading and material assignment are separate from physical filament detection. The slot stays translucent until Canvas detects filament at its inlet; this does not mean RFID is still reading. No load to the nozzle is required to confirm inlet presence.
rfid.lifecycle_confirm: This changes the Canvas RFID application or its host protection. Keep the idle, cold printer powered and connected. Follow each full-printer reboot prompt and retain the original backup. Continue?
rfid.lifecycle_recovery: RFID recovery requires attention. Keep the original backup and operation log; do not retry a firmware transfer or remove the host protection.
rfid.lifecycle_working: RFID preparation or verification is running. Keep the printer powered and connected; wait before restarting.
rfid.lifecycle_restore_reboot: Original Canvas firmware transfer complete. With the printer idle, perform a full reboot to verify the restoration.
rfid.lifecycle_second_reboot: RFID transfer complete. With the printer idle, perform the second full printer reboot. Until then, Canvas may flash red and appear disconnected.
rfid.lifecycle_reboot: A complete idle-printer reboot is required to continue RFID activation or restoration. This notice remains until a different kernel boot is observed.
rfid.lifecycle_dormant: RFID components are installed but not activated. Activation requires a cold, idle printer and complete reboots.
rfid.lifecycle_stock: The original Canvas firmware was verified after reboot. You can now restore the printer startup files.
rfid.lifecycle_action_failed: Operation did not complete. Check that the printer is idle and cold and that Canvas is connected. Review the RFID log before retrying.
rfid.lifecycle_waiting: Waiting for the Canvas check to complete.
rfid.lifecycle_validation_ready: First restart complete. You can continue validating the Canvas RFID update.
rfid.lifecycle_validation_confirm: Continue validating the Canvas RFID update? If the checks pass, the firmware transfer will begin. Keep the printer idle, cold and powered until the next restart prompt.
rfid.lifecycle_restore_confirm: Restore the original Canvas firmware? Keep the idle, cold printer powered and connected until prompted to reboot.
rfid.lifecycle_remove_confirm: Restore the original printer startup files? Keep the idle, cold printer powered and connected until prompted to reboot.
queue.title: Print queue
queue.subtitle: Files, settings and copies prepared ahead. Each copy starts with one button, without the print dialog.
queue.check_file_missing: File not found: {where}. The job cannot start
queue.check_slot_empty: Slot {n} is empty and no other slot holds the same filament. The job cannot start
queue.check_filament_absent: This job's filament is in no Canvas slot. Load it into any slot and set that slot's filament, or give the job another filament. The job cannot start
queue.check_canvas_unknown: The Canvas has not reported its slots, so this job's filament cannot be found. The job cannot start
queue.canvas_check_failed: The Canvas did not report its slots in time, so the job was not started. Check the Canvas and start it again.
queue.check_calibrate: Side {side}: bed calibration before the print
queue.check_mesh_missing: Side {side}: no saved mesh, the copy starts with a calibration
queue.remove_part_hint: Remove the part from the bed first. The print starts at once: the job is already prepared.
queue.start_locked: Available once this print has finished.
queue.policy_wait_hint: The next copy starts from Start print (web, phone, notice): the part is removed first.
queue.policy_delay_label: Delay before an automatic start, seconds
queue.policy_auto_warning: Only for a bed that clears itself. Otherwise the nozzle hits the printed part.
queue.remove_done: Remove a job after its last copy
queue.list_hint: Drag a job by its picture or use the arrows to reorder.
queue.not_started: The printer did not report the last start
queue.stopped: The last copy was stopped and not counted
queue.empty_hint: Open Files, press Print on a G-code file and choose “Add to queue” in the dialog: the number of copies and the print settings are set once there. Each copy then starts with one button.
queue.filament_hint: A queued job prints with its filament from whichever Canvas slot holds it. Choose a slot to give the job the filament that slot holds now, or a filament that is in no slot yet.
queue.filament_stock_hint: For a queued job: it keeps the material and the colour, and waits until a Canvas slot holds that filament.
queue.filament_stock_choose: Choose the brand, the material and the colour of the filament.
queue.nothing_to_start: No job can start: the files of the waiting jobs are missing.
print.queue_position_end: At the end of the queue
print.queue_copies_hint: Each copy is a separate print: the part is removed between them. The choices above are kept with the job; a start from the queue shows no dialog.
print.run_now_hint: The print starts right after confirmation, as before. The queue is not affected.
queue.auto_material: Automatic start held: this job's filament is in no Canvas slot, the slot does not hold the file's material, or it could not be checked. Check and start by hand.
bed.measure_order: The numbers are the probing order, starting at the front left.
bed.tram_start_hint: Bed to 60 °C, clean the nozzle, and visit each screw; afterwards only the nozzle turns off and the bed stays at 60 °C. The printer must be idle.
bed.tram_check_hint: Final check of all four. Homes Z only.
bed.tram_end_hint: Ends the session and switches the heaters off. Then level again and check the mesh. The four points show the tilt and the warp of the plate together.
bed.tram_step_adjust: 2. Turn a screw, then re-probe that corner
bed.tram_reference_stale: Front left has moved by {amount}. The other values no longer match. Check all four.
bed.tram_reference_stable: Reference is stable ({amount}); the other values still apply.
bed.tram_reference_expected: Front left has moved by {amount}. That is the next step of the optimised plan. Check all four next.
bed.tram_one_shot_help: Measures all four once and does not keep a session for re-probing one corner.
bed.tram_one_shot_busy: Unavailable while a session is running.
bed.front_left_reference_optimized: The differences are the recommended turns, and the front-left screw is included. A positive difference means this corner is higher, so lower it. A negative difference means it is lower, so raise it.
bed.tram_check_confirm: Re-probe all four corners? Z is homed; X and Y are not re-homed.
bed.tram_end_confirm: End the screw-levelling session and switch the heaters off?
bed.tram_help: Follow the steps in order. Re-probing homes Z only, so the front-left reference stays.
bed.tram_probe_twice_hint: Applies to re-probe and check. If the two values differ, the nozzle has not settled yet.
bed.tram_settle: Every measurement waits {seconds} s for the nozzle to settle.
bed.tram_start_confirm: Home all axes, heat the bed to 60 °C, clean the nozzle, and measure all four screws? The toolhead will move. Afterwards only the nozzle turns off and the bed stays at 60 °C. The printer must be idle. Every measurement waits {seconds} s before probing.
job.bed_map_layer_limit: Layer path skipped: file too large to scan in time
